passive.name: Ancestry Passive
passive.text: Collect 2 random basic Resources at check-in. You may choose to gain 10 bits instead of Resources.

sharedAbility.name: Human Resilience
sharedAbility.text: Perform one of the following actions during bleed out. Use a consumable or use a single skill that does not take a counted action.

ability.name: Make It Work
ability.text: Use this Skill to treat any single Resource as a different Resource of the same Rarity. You may also combine 2 Resources into 1 Resource of a higher Rarity.

ability.name: Deep Pockets
ability.text: Collect 2 additional Resources per level at Check-In. You may instead stack additional uses to collect higher level Resources. You may choose to gain 10 Bits instead of resources per level of this skill.

ability.name: Engineered Metabolism
ability.text: Use this Skill to also Heal 10 when you use any consumable or eat food. If the item would cause a negative effect, it is negated.

ancestries.name: Elf
ancestries.costumeRequirements: Pointed ears. These do not have to be a certain size as there is significant variation in ear lengths among elves.

sharedAbility.name: Quick Reflexes
sharedAbility.text: Use this Skill as a Sidestep. You may use this Skill with a use of Sidestep to Upgrade it to an Evade. (You can also use 2 Uses of this Skill to use 1 Evade)

ability.name: Accuracy
ability.text: Spend a use of this Skill to regain a use of a Basic Offensive Skill immediately after it is resisted. (You may spend multiple uses at once to reuse a higher-level Skill)

ability.name: Shrug It Off
ability.text: When hit with a Slow effect or any effect that affects the damage you do or take you may call "Resist X" where X is the status being resisted.

passive.name: Ancestry Passive
passive.text: May reduce any magical numerical effect that affects them by 2 to a minimum of 1.

sharedAbility.name: Made From Magic
sharedAbility.text: May use this skill as a basic use of Resist Magic. (This may not be upgraded to adept or advanced)

ability.name: You Saw Nothing
ability.text: Spend a use of this Skill to regain a use of a Basic Magic Skill immediately after it is resisted. (You may spend multiple uses at once to reuse a higher-level Skill)

ability.name: Fae Blessing
ability.text: Spend a use of this Skill to grant the target an additional Buff Slot.

ancestries.name: Hybrid
ancestries.costumeRequirements: Incorporate obvious plant AND animal features into your costuming and/or makeup. Animal-dominant Hybrids should have more animal elements than plant elements and plant-dominant Hybrids should incorporate more plant elements than animal elements.

sharedAbility.name: Made for This
sharedAbility.text: Transfer a disease or poison effect from someone else to yourself or resist a disease or poison effect.

passive.name: Ancestry Passive
passive.text: Halve any disease, poison or corruption numerical effect.

ability.name: Natural Medicine
ability.text: Heal anyone but yourself 20 Health on a 5 count.

passive.name: Ancestry Passive
passive.text: Gain 2 Short Claws or 1 Great Claw. Claws count as Weapons for the purpose of Weapon Abilities.

ability.name: Animal Charm
ability.text: May "Point Charm Befriend" a target after at least 10 seconds of conversation and you have not taken a hostile action towards them this encounter.

ancestries.name: Conscious
ancestries.costumeRequirements: For both varieties, have makeup and clothing that appear corpse-like (but not just pale). For mushroom variety, have a significant number of mushrooms on your body or clothing. For insect variety, have fake insects on your body or clothing; these should be clearly visible. Spiders are not an option.

sharedAbility.name: Durable Body
sharedAbility.text: May be used as a use of Basic Endurance or at the end of your Bleedout Count spend a use to reset your Bleedout Count. (This use of basic endurance may not be upgraded to adept or advanced)

ability.name: Fungal Growth
ability.text: Spend a 3 count to heal 20 Health on yourself.

ability.name: Chitinous Carapace
ability.text: Spend a 3 count to either refit your armor fully or gain +20 Temp armor if you have none. Temp armor cannot be refitted.

ancestries.name: Aware
ancestries.costumeRequirements: Pale makeup and white, gray, and light blue color clothing. Items that Aware have put over their death attire do not have to be in this color scheme. Their Beacons are not required to be white, gray, or light blue.

passive.name: Ancestry Passive
passive.text: All upkeep costs are zero. Immune to Infection and disease effects (but not damage) and can always see Spirits but cannot be healed by normal means. Only healing that specifically specifies that it heals Aware will work. Gains Connection Damage instead of Infection.

sharedAbility.name: Ghostly
sharedAbility.text: You may call "Passwall" and do a 3 Count to pass through a 5 foot wall. If the wall is too thick, the Passwall will fail. You may spend additional uses to extend the length of the Passwall.

ability.name: Protective Memory
ability.text: You may Hero Resist a Status effect for someone else hit within Melee Weapon range of you.

ability.name: Vengeful Persistence
ability.text: Remove any movement impairing effect on yourself.

ancestries.name: Burrower
ancestries.costumeRequirements: Large mouse-like ears, tail, and a dark circle at the end of your nose.

passive.name: Ancestry Passive
passive.text: If you serve someone food and then they spend 5 minutes eating it and resting they will heal half their max HP. A single character may only benefit from this effect once an hour.

sharedAbility.name: You Didn't See Me
sharedAbility.text: Throw a single packet for "Charm Ignore 10 seconds".

ability.name: Look What I made!
ability.text: Expend an ingestible Basic Consumable along with this Skill to prepare the Consumable into snacks. One use of this Skill will allow you to make the Consumable into snacks that will serve 2 people. Anyone who eats the snacks gains the benefit of the ingestible you expended along with this Skill. The snacks will last until the end of the Repop. You may spend additional uses to upgrade the level of Consumable this works with.

ability.name: Look What I found!
ability.text: For each level of this Skill you may draw 2 random Items at Check-In. It could either be a random Resource or a non-mastery Consumable that can only be used for this event after which it falls apart.

ancestries.name: Cryptid
ancestries.costumeRequirements: Clearly not a member of another playable Ancestry. Particular requirements will be set by GMs on a case-by-case basis and final costuming must be approved by at least 2 GMs to ensure they are larp safe, player safe, and not accidentally offensive in any way.

passive.name: Ancestry Passive
passive.text: Gain 2 Short Claws or 1 Great Claw. Claws count as Weapons for the purpose of Weapon Abilities.

sharedAbility.name: From Legends

choice.text: any sharedAbility or subtype ability of a non-cryptid ancestry whose frequency is per-encounter or per-repop
choice.assumptionNote: Q-ANC-2: whether the choice can change later is not stated.

sharedAbility.text: Replace this with any Per/Encounter or Per/Repop Ancestry Ability of a non-cryptid Ancestry.

ability.name: Quick! Blend In!
ability.text: May Disguise themselves as any Ancestry. The Disguise lasts for an Encounter. Passive: May choose a specific ancestry at the beginning of the event and wear a costume disguise that simulates that ancestry.

ability.name: Chameleon Skin
ability.text: May call "Invisibility" and cross your arms in front of you to Hide in any location. As long as you remain still you count as being fully Hidden. If you move it will break the Hide.

ability.name: Water Bubble
ability.text: Throw a packet with the call "Slow 10". The target struck is slowed for 10 seconds.

ability.name: Land on your feet
ability.text: May resist any Knockback, Trip, Slick, or Pull effect.

ability.name: A little Sniff!
ability.text: When attempting to Track via smell gain +2 to your tracking. You may stack this effect with additional uses.

ability.name: Take Wing
ability.text: May be used as a 6 Second Basic Dash or extend any use of Dash to 6 Seconds.
